rfe-reviews/{ID}-review.md
---
rfe_id: {ID}
score: {int} pass: {bool}
recommendation:
submit|revise|split|
reject|autorevise_reject
feasibility:
feasible|infeasible|
indeterminate
auto_revised: {bool}
needs_attention: {bool}
scores: what/why/open_to_how
/not_a_task/right_sized (0-2)
before_score / before_scores
---

## Strategy Considerations
